headline: Mondelez’s (MDLZ) Earnings Beat May Matter Less Than Its 2027 Growth Bet
summary: While cost-conscious buyers in developed markets continue to face cumulative inflation and greater scrutiny around discretionary snack consumption, international demand in emerging economies remains structurally strong. Mega-cap CPG giants such as Mondelez International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) must balance pricing power with aggressive brand investments to capitalize on this environment.
